# EWS archive support resolves the archive role and exposes its folder flag

The historical patch requests distinguished archive and maps that role to nsMsgFolderFlags::Archive, replacing archiveinbox. The callback combines it with Mail; fake-server and extension expected data expose an Archives folder with archives specialUse. This is role/flag coverage, not an archive-message operation or a universal English folder-name assumption. Current missing-optional-folder handling is later context. The extension deep comparison passes its strict object as description under the actual helper signature, so strict options are not enabled and the call lacks a concrete expected-behavior message; it still checks expected fields and array length. No server, folder or test operation ran.

Scope: Exchange distinguished folder identity and extension folder data.
